from pathlib import Path
folder=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792485492/attempts/9f509ca37a0f4b279e3de00a5074f14c/system/state/workspace/programs')
folder.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
source='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    solid_rows = [(r, grid[r][0]) for r in range(h) if all(v == grid[r][0] for v in grid[r])]
    solid_cols = [(c, grid[0][c]) for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == grid[0][c] for r in range(h))]
    for r, color in solid_rows:
        for c in range(w):
            out[r][c] = 2
    for c, color in solid_cols:
        for r in range(h):
            out[r][c] = 2
    return out
'''
p=folder/'task-aab4e1e4.py'
p.write_text(source)
exec(compile(source, str(p), 'exec'), globals())
test=[[7,7,5,5,7,7,5,7],[7,7,5,5,5,7,7,7],[7,7,5,5,7,7,7,7],[7,7,5,5,7,7,7,7],[5,7,5,5,7,7,7,7],[7,5,5,5,7,5,7,5],[7,7,5,5,7,7,5,7],[7,7,5,5,5,7,7,7],[7,7,5,5,7,7,7,7],[5,5,5,5,5,5,5,5],[5,7,5,5,7,7,7,5],[7,7,5,5,7,5,7,7]]
answer=transform(test)
print('solid rows/cols', [i for i,row in enumerate(test) if len(set(row))==1], [j for j in range(len(test[0])) if len({row[j] for row in test})==1])
print('\n'.join(' '.join(map(str,row)) for row in answer))
